review_candidates.title: MEP Engineer
review_candidates.description: 🚨 We’re Hiring | #MEP / #Mechanical_Site_Engineer Amjaad Technology is looking for an experienced MEP / Mechanical Site Engineer to join our team and support the execution of our projects. 📍 Location: #Maadi, Cairo 📌 Experience: 3–4 Years 🔹 #Key_Responsibilities: • Supervise and monitor MEP/Mechanical installation activities according to project specifications, approved drawings, and quality standards. • Review mechanical drawings, BOQs, P&IDs, and technical specifications before and during project execution. • Coordinate HVAC, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, and Mechanical works with other disciplines. • Manage subcontractors, technicians, and site activities to achieve project milestones. • Conduct regular site inspections, identify technical issues, and implement corrective actions. • Coordinate with Project Managers, Electrical & Civil Engineers, Consultants, and other stakeholders. • Ensure all MEP works comply with safety requirements, local regulations, and company procedures. • Monitor project progress and prepare daily, weekly, and monthly site reports. • Coordinate with Procurement and Supply Chain teams to ensure timely availability of materials and equipment. • Support testing, commissioning, system balancing, and project handover activities. • Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and according to required quality standards. 🔹 # Requirements : • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. • 3–4 years of experience as an MEP or Mechanical Site Engineer. • Hands-on experience in HVAC, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, and Mechanical Systems. • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, BOQs, P&IDs, and technical specifications. • Good knowledge of AutoCAD and Microsoft Office. • Experience in installation, testing, and commissioning activities. • Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. • Good understanding of project execution and site management. • Ability to travel between project sites when required. 📩 Interested candidates are invited to send their CVs to: m.nagy@amjaadiot.com #Hiring #AmjaadTechnology #MEP #MechanicalEngineer #MechanicalSiteEngineer #SiteEngineer #HVAC #Plumbing #FireFighting #EngineeringJobs #CairoJobs #EgyptJobs #ConstructionJobs

review_candidates.title: Procurement Specialist III
review_candidates.location: Al Ḩamul, Kafr ash Shaykh, Egypt
review_candidates.description: TSC is seeking a forward-thinking & highly motivated Procurement Specialist III to oversee the material planning process, ensuring the availability of materials for production while optimizing inventory levels and driving strategic improvements. The ideal candidate will act as a key liaison between Procurement, Production, and Program Management Teams, providing leadership and expertise to support the successful execution of TSC’s contracts. This is an hybrid position supporting TSC’s Huntsville AL location reporting to the Purchasing Manager. Remote working options with onsite meetings. Responsibilities: Develop and manage advanced material requirements plans (MRP) to support complex production schedules and contract deliverables. Analyze long-term demand forecasts, production schedules, and inventory trends to ensure material availability and cost efficiency. Assist leading cross-functional teams to address material planning challenges and implement solutions. Serve as the primary point of contact for material planning issues, providing guidance to junior planners and procurement teams. Collaborate with Procurement to ensure timely placement of purchase orders and delivery of materials. Develop strategies to optimize inventory levels, reduce excess and obsolete inventory, and minimize waste. Work closely with Production and Program Management teams to address material shortages and ensure uninterrupted operations. Adjust material plans to accommodate changes in production schedules, contract requirements, or unforeseen challenges. Identify and implement process improvements to enhance material planning efficiency and accuracy. Leverage data analytics, MRP system capabilities, and industry best practices to drive innovation in material planning processes. Manage daily activities of direct reports. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field. Minimum 5-7 years of experience in material planning, supply chain management, or production planning, in the defense or aerospace industry or combination of degree and years of experiment. Extensive experience with MRP/ERP systems (e.g. Deltek CostPoint, SAP, Oracle, etc.) Advanced understanding of material planning processes, inventory management principles, and supply chain optimization. Familiarity with defense industry supply chain challenges and best practices. Strong leadership and decision-making abilities. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. US Citizenship TSC Benefits: TSC offers a stable work environment, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package; including ESOP participation, 401k Plan, Flexible Work Schedules, Tuition Reimbursement, Co-Sponsored Health Plan, Paid Leave and much more. Applying to TSC: Only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Employment at TSC is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check, security investigation, and a drug screening. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, TSC is an employee-owned company that has been providing high-quality technical services and solutions for over 50 years. Our diverse portfolio includes providing; Airborne Sensors and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR); Electronic Warfare Systems; Air and Missile Defense; Space Systems, and Intelligence and Information Systems. TSC offers a professional working environment, a competitive salary, and an excellent benefits package. This contractor and subcontractor shall abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60–1.4(a), 60–300.5(a) and 60–741.5(a). These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or for inquiring about, discussing, or disclosing information about compensation. Moreover, these regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
